g.text: Asgard LXCs: what runs outside K3s, and where
One host per column. Pairs and trios are spread so no single host takes a whole service down. Dashed = root-auth Terraform module.
Skuld has an open hardware fault
roles avoid it: the exit node and PBS
live elsewhere; only pair members and
root password in env): only for
Every LXC is also declared in NetBox
Shared addresses: the AdGuard trio shares
one VIP; PG goes through the HAProxy trio's
VIP. The Tailscale trio is one per host.
Sources: docs/services/asgard-lxcs.md, docs/architecture/hardware.md. IDs and addresses are in the text docs; none are on this page.
